name: polaris-navdata
description: SIDs, STARs and approaches, and the live values for the Backup PFD, Ground (GSX) and the OOOI times, from MSFS (SimConnect) or X-Plane 12 (its CIFP data and Web API), for the Polaris EFB on ws://localhost:2050; started by the EFB (closes 10 minutes after it) or, as the pilot chooses, with Windows in the background

scripts.test: node test_fixture.js && node test_msfs.js && node test_xplane.js && node test_life.js
scripts.build: esbuild main.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/navdata-bundle.js && pkg dist/navdata-bundle.js -t node22-win-x64 -o dist/PolarisNavdata.exe --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" --public
